test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Hiten marks his pen at Rs. 28875 and after allowing discount of 20 percent, he still earns 40 percent profit. What is the cost price of the pen?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the pen = Rs. 28875

Discount = 20%

Profit = 40%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) after discount = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price / (1 + Profit%)
